Each session includes a 5-minute warm-up (e.g., Arm circles or light Walking) followed by the main exercises. Rest periods are set to 45 seconds to allow for recovery while maintaining a steady pace. As strength improves, increase the number of repetitions or add light dumbbell weight to the Squats and Bicep curls.
content.safety_note: Always perform a proper warm-up before starting. Maintain correct form, especially during Squats and Push-ups, to prevent injury. If you experience any pain, stop the exercise immediately. Stay hydrated throughout the session.
